definitions.agency_count: Distinct OPM agency_code values present in that state.
definitions.audit_flags: Outlier and concentration flags for review only. They are not allegations or determinations of wrongdoing.
definitions.component_count: Distinct OPM agency_subelement_code values present in that state.
definitions.high_gs_ses: GS pay plan rows at grades 13-15 plus ES pay plan rows, divided by all public rows in the state.
definitions.land_area: Census 2025 state gazetteer ALAND converted to square miles and square kilometers.
definitions.state_audit_flags: Flags mark top-rank overlap, density, concentration, and no-income-tax context. They are screening indicators for human review, not findings of illegality.
definitions.state_denominator: State metrics use OPM duty_station_state_abbreviation where public rows provide it. Foreign/unmapped rows are counted in the snapshot but not assigned to a state.
definitions.va_facility_patient_data: VA FY25 UniquePatientsByProcedure gives unique patient counts by CPT/procedure and administrative parent facility. Patients can appear in multiple procedure rows, so procedure counts must not be summed as total veterans served.
definitions.va_gdx_fy24: VA FY2024 GDX expenditure fields are state-level dollars. Direct/indirect state sheets in the workbook are published in $000s and converted here to dollars.
definitions.visible_payroll: Sum of numeric OPM annualized_adjusted_basic_pay rows by duty-station state; redacted pay rows are excluded from dollar totals.

snapshot.dataset: OPM Federal Employment Raw Data + Census 2025 state gazetteer + VA FY2024 GDX + VA FY2025 UniquePatientsByProcedure

source_policy: Only OPM, Census, and VA federal .gov sources are used. Audit flags are descriptive outlier/concentration indicators; they are not allegations or determinations of wrongdoing.

limitations: This file does not publish a single total veterans-served count per facility.
Summing procedure rows would double count patients who had more than one procedure or encounter type.
The dataset excludes services provided in the community, and VA notes the National column will not equal a sum of all locations.
va_facility_patient_data.sort_note: largest_single_procedure_unique_patients is the largest official unique-patient count found for one CPT/HCPCS row at that facility, not total facility patients.
